The dark web refers to parts of the inte: The dark web refers to parts of the internet that aren't indexed by normal search engines and are reached with special software. While it has legitimate uses for privacy, it's also used to share stolen account information.

How can your information end up there?: How can your information end up there?
When a company's database is breached, i: When a company's database is breached, information like email addresses, usernames, password hashes, or phone numbers can be stolen. Attackers may share or sell this data. Seeing information on the dark web doesn't mean your phone was directly hacked — most incidents stem from a third-party service breach.
